middle_frame_image.description: Middle guide frame for the same continuous shot, around 2 seconds.

notes: Default request is 4 seconds at 24fps; the LTX guide canvas uses an internal length of 81 so the exported video lands near 97 frames.
This canvas contains only LTX 2.3 and generic ComfyUI nodes; no Wan nodes are used.
Start frame maps to LoadImage node 2, middle frame maps to node 29, and end frame maps to node 3.
Start frame uses LTXVImgToVideoAdvanced at index 0, middle frame uses LTXVAddGuideAdvanced at frame_idx=40, and end frame uses LTXVAddGuideAdvancedAttention at frame_idx=72.
Use only for three consistent states of one continuous shot; otherwise downgrade to first-frame I2V or split the shot.
